changelog: AI curation of every personalized surface (opt-in 'Enable AI curation of personalized rows'): the LLM now genuinely selects the For You row and Spotlight from a wide locally-ranked pool (instead of only re-ordering the top picks), curates the daily mood collections so each row only contains titles that truly carry the mood, picks the More Like This titles a fan of the source would actually reach for, and orders Coming Soon by how much each viewer will care (state logic still decides what appears - nothing airs unseen). List rows - trending, popular in your country, recently added - stay algorithmic by design. Every surface degrades to the built-in local ranking if the model is unavailable, and results are cached per surface to keep API usage small. Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint configured in the AI section.
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
name: Orca Engine
overview: The brain/backbone for the Orca X Android TV client.
